sentences.en: The wild and windy night that the rain washed away.
sentences.zh: 那被雨水冲刷掉的狂野多风的夜晚。

sentences.en: Eastern Montana is especially windy and cold in the winter.
sentences.zh: 蒙大拿州东部在冬天尤其多风且寒冷。

sentences.en: We should have gone sailing yesterday when it was windy.
sentences.zh: 我们本应该在昨天有风的时候去航海。
